en: Black‑and‑white view of a European market square with cobblestone ground and rows of stalls selling goods, many people in early‑20th‑century dress, and horse carts. On the left and center stand narrow gabled townhouses with steep tiled roofs and painted façades bearing German‑language shop signs. In the background, on a hill above the town, rises a large fortified castle complex with towers and massive walls, overlooking the square.
